content: ntfy publish API (docs.ntfy.sh/publish, fetched 2026-08): PUT/POST to /<topic> with headers/query or JSON body to root. Fields: title, message (4096B max), priority 1-5 (min/low/default/high/urgent), tags (emoji shortcode mapping), click URL, icon URL, markdown opt-in (X-Markdown header or text/markdown content-type; rendered in web app only), attachments (upload 15MB or external URL, 3h expiry), actions array (up to 3: view/broadcast/http/copy; http action = client device fires POST/GET/PUT with headers+body directly at target URL, clear=true on success), delay/scheduled delivery (10s-3d), email forwarding, phone call TTS, sequence_id for update/clear/delete of delivered notifications, Go-template webhook message templating (github/grafana/alertmanager presets), GET /publish one-call webhooks. Auth: Basic or tk_ access tokens, auth query param, per-topic ACL. Cache 12h default. ntfy.sh limits: 250 msgs/day/visitor, 30 connections.
